audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer calls this a 'Favoured matchup — difficulty 4/10' and gives Neeko every row of the level chart, while the packet reports a 25% win rate and a chart of Skill/Skill/Aatrox/Aatrox/Aatrox/Aatrox/Skill. The content layer's whys already describe an Aatrox-favoured lane.
audit.why: Two layers rendering opposite verdicts on the same page. The content whys and the packet agree; the full layer is the outlier.
audit.corrected: diff set to HARD, diffRating 7/10, carryRating 7/10, and every phases[N].side/rating realigned to the packet chart in matched pairs with win[N].

audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer treats Level 6 and first item as Neeko spikes; in reality World Ender (R, 120/100/80s) is the lane's biggest spike and his first-item sustain out-heals a single E-Q rotation.
audit.why: Aatrox's R gives attack damage, increased healing and move speed and extends on takedown — it beats a one-rotation burst pattern.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why and phases[5].why rewritten to name World Ender and his healing; dosFull[2] now gives the real 120s number instead of a fabricated 'fifteen-second' window.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer never names a single Aatrox ability except World Ender, and report[5] 'Key Ability Interactions' contains no interaction at all. wants.you[1] and mid both claim 'Shapesplitter (W) invisibility', which Riot's description of Neeko's W does not contain — it sends a clone and can be recast to redirect it.
audit.why: Advice built on an ability effect that is not in the kit text is unsafe; the actual decisive interaction is Infernal Chains (W) dragging you back to its centre to set up the sweetspot Darkin Blade (Q) knockup.
audit.corrected: report[5] now states the Chains-into-sweetspot-Q sequence; wants.you[1] and mid switched from invisibility to the clone as a bait tool; Deathbringer Stance (P) and Umbral Dash (E) healing flagged as the Grievous Wounds target (already carried in report[8]).

audit.why: World Ender at 120s rank 1 is correctly identified as the punishable cooldown; only the fabricated duration was fixed.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2].t said 'Save E to interrupt World Ender'. Nothing in Riot's description makes World Ender a channel or interruptible.
audit.why: Telling a player to hold their only CC for an interrupt that does not exist loses them the trade.

edits.before: Stormsurge spike — a rooted target now loses half their HP to one rotation.

edits.before: You're the teamfight flank now: disguise, walk into the clump, and R three people. Lane leads become fight wins.

edits.before: Once he hits his Q-W-E combo and his passive heal-on-hit is rolling, extended trades are a trap — every auto he lands heals him and my single Q-E rotation doesn't out-damage that. At 6 his R is the scariest window in the lane: combat stats plus a heal spike means if his W drags me into the knockup he kills me before my Pop Blossom (R) channel even lands. At 6 World Ender (R) is the scariest window in the lane: combat stats plus a heal spike means if his W drags me into the knockup he kills me before Pop Blossom (R) lands. I'd rather ult unseen for a roam than duel him.
